prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **ATA Martial Arts – St. Peters** if you’re looking for a structured program with a traditional martial-arts focus. It offers **ATA Tigers for ages 4–6** and kids’ classes for **ages 7–12**, with an emphasis on confidence, discipline, and self-defense. It’s at **6720 Mexico Rd**; call **(636) 556-5271** to ask about schedules and trial options. [Program details](https://www.atastpeters.com/our-classes)

If you’d rather explore grappling, **Onyx Grappling** offers kids’ Brazilian jiu-jitsu classes at **953 Jungermann Rd**; its site lists age-grouped classes and a free introductory class. [Kids’ program](https://onyxgrappling.com/martial-arts-for-kids-near-me/)

I’d visit or try a class at both before committing. Watch how instructors manage the kids, whether beginners get individual attention, and whether the class feels encouraging and safe. Check current schedules and trial terms directly with the schools.
